author: Nomos III
title: Stagnation Protocol Idea 2: Auxiliary Box Counting
abstract: This is the second experiment for the Stagnation Protocol. It tests if adding an auxiliary predictive task can improve the baseline SingleStepWideLSTM (85.4). A new head is added to the CNN backbone to predict the number of off-target boxes, with its L2 loss added to the main PPO loss. This aims to encourage richer feature learning.
